description: This file defines the DiagnosisDAO interface for database operations related to diagnosis objects within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes method signatures for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting diagnosis data, as well as querying related attributes and diagnoses by encounter, visit, or patient.

classes.name: DiagnosisDAO
classes.description: Interface for diagnosis database operations, including CRUD and query methods for Diagnosis entities.

methods.name: saveDiagnosis
methods.description: Saves a Diagnosis object to the database and returns the saved object.

methods.name: getDiagnosisById
methods.description: Retrieves a Diagnosis by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getDiagnosisByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Diagnosis using its UUID.

methods.name: deleteDiagnosis
methods.description: Deletes a specified Diagnosis from the database.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByEncounter
methods.description: Returns a list of diagnoses associated with a specific encounter, with options for filtering primary and confirmed diagnoses.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByVisit
methods.description: Returns a list of diagnoses associated with a specific visit, with filtering options.

methods.name: getActiveDiagnoses
methods.description: Fetches all active diagnoses for a particular patient starting from a specified date.

methods.name: getAllDiagnosisAttributeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of all DiagnosisAttributeType entities.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeById
methods.description: Retrieves a DiagnosisAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a DiagnosisAttributeType using its UUID.

methods.name: saveDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Saves a DiagnosisAttributeType to the database.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a DiagnosisAttribute by its UUID.
